location: Remote · Santo Domingo de los Tsáchilas, Ecuador
description: Leads the architecture and evolution of enterprise mobile banking platforms.

Founder and Development Team Manager at Meniuz. I lead mobile projects for iOS and Android, focused on building solutions that connect users with the best restaurants, coffee shops, ice cream parlors, and liquor stores in Ecuador.

Meniuz features a comprehensive and updated menu database, driving the digital transformation of the local gastronomy industry. I oversee product strategy, mobile engineering, and team leadership to deliver a platform that helps businesses and diners discover great food experiences across the country.

At EDteam, I work as a freelance instructor and technical content creator, designing courses, hands-on labs, and real-world projects focused on application development, software architecture, modern backend systems, and AI integration into production-ready products.

I build learning experiences focused on "learning by building," creating practical applications and examples using technologies such as Swift, Kotlin, React, TypeScript, Firebase, Spring Boot, Docker, and cloud services. I also research and adapt emerging technologies for up-to-date educational content, including Generative AI, Agent Platform (Vertex AI), cross-platform development, and modern tools from the Google and Apple ecosystems.

Additionally, I contribute to curriculum planning, demo project architecture, educational experience optimization, and the creation of industry-oriented technical content for developers and engineering teams.

I lead the management and execution of custom software projects focused on empowering local and national businesses. I coordinate multidisciplinary teams to deliver efficient, scalable, and tailor-made technological solutions aligned with each client's specific needs.

My work combines strategic planning, process monitoring, and constant communication with stakeholders to ensure high-impact and high-quality results—from mobile and web products to enterprise solutions built with modern stacks and agile delivery practices.

At DevLokos, I build a community where technology and software development come together. Through the DevLokos Podcast, I host interviews with IT leaders, discuss the latest in technology, and share practical knowledge for developers growing their careers.

I also lead workshops, live sessions, and community initiatives that strengthen Ecuador's tech ecosystem—creating spaces where innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning drive progress.

As Lead Organizer of GDG Santo Domingo de los Tsáchilas, I plan and execute tech events that connect developers with Google technologies, practical workshops, and community networking.

I'm an Android developer and speaker experienced in building mobile applications and sharing knowledge through talks and hands-on sessions. My work focuses on fostering local talent, promoting continuous learning, and growing an inclusive developer community in the Santo Domingo de los Tsáchilas region.

As the Cursor Ambassador for Ecuador, I represented the platform and its vision to integrate artificial intelligence into developers' everyday workflows.

From November 2025 to September 2026, I promoted Cursor as an AI-powered development environment and helped professionals write, optimize, and understand code more efficiently.

Through DevLokos, I led events, workshops, and community initiatives aimed at practical learning and at strengthening Ecuador's tech ecosystem — a chapter that now continues as Build Ambassador in the SpaceXSI Community.
